claims.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum gripper element (1) and a vacuum gripper device (24) which are designed to suck against or to hold a component that is to be transported when a vacuum is supplied.
claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper device designed to suck or hold a component, which is a vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.quote: A base body (2) with at least one vacuum supply channel (3), - An elastic, shape-flexible sealing element (4) which is connected to the base body (2) and is provided for sealing contact with the component to be transported
claims.note: The reference discloses a base body (carrier plate) and a sealing element connected to it for sealing contact, but does not explicitly state that the seal extends around the carrier plate.
This claim refers to 'said grip unit according to claim 1', but claim 1 of the subject invention is not provided, making it impossible to assess this limitation.

claims.quote: A first fastening means (5) is formed here by a detent coupling (8) for interlocking connection and release of the vacuum gripper element (1) to/from the support device (6) as necessary.

claims.quote: The vacuum gripper element (1) comprises a main body (2) having at least one vacuum supply channel (3) and a resilient, flexible sealing element (4).
